title: Capture handles optional steps, vanished targets, captions and waits without false failures

fields.outcome: A documentation author can capture a manual without writing custom steps for optional clicks, after-screenshots, text conditions, navigation or asserts. Capture no longer fails on these cases; when it has to change what a screenshot shows, it says so in a warning.
fields.scope: In: the eight capture fixes of phase 3 in docs/plans/0.7.0.md (optional steps, after-screenshots, captions, text conditions, navigation retry, assert fallback, hidden waits with stableForMs, target-matching docs), capture warnings in the captureJourney/regenerate results and in run-docs output, a specification-level captionInImage. Out: the backlog items (within scope, name patterns, hover, new windows, scrollTo, network idle exceptions, read-only checks, hide, screenshot expectations), an exact flag on targets, changing the annotation parser's text= handling.
fields.notes: Source: autotour-feedback.md items 5, 20–25 and 27 (Agile Office and Agile Objects manuals, 2026-11-04/06). Phase 3 of the agreed 0.7.0 plan.
fields.decisions: Optional steps whose target is absent are skipped entirely (no screenshot, no step hooks) and reported; a documentation block for such a step is then reported as not captured. After-screenshots fall back to expect.target only when the highlight came from the step target, never over an explicit annotation.target. Text without a target is a whitespace-insensitive contains-match on the page's visible text; with a target it stays an exact textContent match. Hidden/detached with stableForMs means continuously absent for that long. captionInImage resolves block > specification > recordScreenshots > on.
fields.verification: tests/capture/capture-fixes.test.js has one test per criterion (target-matching docs are reviewed in docs/reliable-tours.md). Red run on develop 25fdf43+0327d93 before the fix: .agenthouse/evidence/ST-31/red.tap (8 of 8 failed). Green run and npm run check: see the pull request.

criteria.expectation: An optional step whose target is absent is skipped: no screenshot, no failure, and a warning naming the module and step.
An after-action screenshot whose step target is gone highlights expect.target, with a warning, instead of failing.
The specification's captionInImage reaches every screenshot step unless a block sets its own; when neither does, recordScreenshots.captionInImage decides.
A caption that would cover the target is left out of the image and reported as a capture warning.
expect.text without a target passes when the page shows that text, and fails with a message naming the text otherwise.
A condition measured while the page navigates waits for the new document and measures again instead of failing with 'Execution context was destroyed'.
An assert with only expect waits for expect.target instead of failing with 'assert steps require url or target'.
state hidden or detached with stableForMs returns only after the target has been absent for that long without interruption.
